concerns.text: The specification enumerates many engineering‑focused functional requirements (e.g., FR‑020 linting limits, FR‑021 CI workflow generation, FR‑011 README creation, FR‑021 requirements.txt) that were never part of the original idea. These expand the project scope beyond the scientific goal of correlating compositional descriptors with yield strength.

A large set of JSON‑schema validation requirements (FR‑013, FR‑018, FR‑019, FR‑020, etc.) and contracts are introduced without justification from the idea. The original proposal only required basic dataset validation; the added schema coverage constitutes scope over‑reach.

Handling of duplicate rows (FR‑012) and unknown element warnings (FR‑007) are specified, yet the idea never mentioned these edge cases. Including them adds work not requested by the research question.
